entities.summary: Samir ibn Zafar Khan was a Saudi Arabian naturalized U.S. citizen, jihadist militant, and the editor and publisher of Inspire, an English-language online magazine reported to be published by the Islamic terrorist group al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula (AQAP). He was killed in a drone strike in Yemen together with Anwar al-Awlaki.
